errors.detail: ContactFlow has contactCompartment=//@compartments.1 and target=//@compartments.1. These should be different compartments. ContactFlow moves source to target upon contact with contactCompartment.
Compartment 'Susceptible' has population=0 and no incoming flow or externalSource. Susceptible compartments typically need recruitment.
All 6 compartments have population=0. This indicates a critical extraction failure.

outgoing_flows.description: Infection of susceptible individuals at force of infection λ(t) = β * I(t)/N
Progression through first exposed sub-compartment at rate σ
Progression from exposed to infectious at rate σ
Progression through first infectious sub-compartment at rate γ

parameters.name: σ
parameters.description: Daily rate of transition between exposed sub-compartments (E1 to E2 and E2 to I1), leading to average incubation period dL = 2/σ days

parameters.name: γ
parameters.description: Daily rate of transition between infectious sub-compartments (I1 to I2 and I2 to R), leading to average infectious period dI = 2/γ days

parameters.name: π
parameters.description: Proportion of the population who are initially susceptible (susceptibility)

parameters.name: ψ
parameters.description: Exponential growth rate (EGR) at which compartments E1, E2, I1, I2 grow initially

parameters.name: η
parameters.description: Over-dispersion parameter of the Negative Binomial observation model

parameters.name: pICU
parameters.description: Probability of ICU/HDU admission given infection

parameters.name: µICU|E
parameters.description: Mean time from infection to ICU admission (Gamma distributed waiting time)

parameters.name: σ2ICU|E
parameters.description: Variance of time from infection to ICU admission

parameters.name: β
parameters.description: Transmission rate (rate at which new infections take place given a contact)

parameters.name: R0
parameters.description: Basic reproduction number, average number of successful transmissions per infectious person in a fully susceptible population

parameters.name: Rn
parameters.description: Effective reproduction number, average number of successful transmissions per infectious person in a partially susceptible population

parameters.name: δt
parameters.description: Discrete time step length (quarter of a day)
